sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Healthcare / Diagnostics & Research · Indonesia. PT Prodia Widyahusada Tbk provides clinical laboratory services in Indonesia. The company offers test services, such as genomic, laboratory, and non-laboratory tests, as well as test panels; doctor consultation and teleconsultation services; vaccines; home services; and research support services. It also engages in the operation of Prodia Health Care, a personalized medicine-based wellness clinic; and specialty clinics, including Prodia Children, Prodia Women, and Prodia Senior.
